root: ^Mr. Ramonts! My name's Chemy, I saw your request on the town board, so I brought the Hunger Potion you asked for.
^Ah, thank you, Chemy. You have my gratitude.
^So, your sister is coming to visit, yes? She must make quite the generous amount of food if you need a hunger potion.
^'Generous amount' is underselling it... but this time I WILL eat all of it.
^Hehe, I'm sure you will! A Hunger Potion's effects are no joke.
^Thank you, Chemy. I really appreicate it.
